name: Fan Tray
summary: A chat message box whose + button swings open a fan of tools you can tap or slide onto
about: A chat composer for support chats, shops or assistants. Press the + and a curved tray swings open like a hand fan, its five tools springing out one after another. Tap a tool, or hold the + and slide your finger onto one and let go. Each pick flies into the message box as a chip: a real photo or file you choose, a location, a poll or a short voice note. Send pops your bubble into the chat and a reply follows.
how: Tap the + (or press Enter on it) to swing the fan open; the + turns into a × and the chat behind blurs.
Tap a tool, or press and hold the +, slide onto a tool and release; arrow keys move between tools and Escape closes the fan.
Photo and Document open your file picker and show the real file name and size; Location, Poll and Voice add their own chips, which fly into place and can be removed.
Type a message and press Send or Enter: the plane flies off, your bubble springs into the chat, a typing dot appears and a reply arrives.
